description: Frame test fixture, not a field. The minimal conformant pack, used to prove the frame has no hidden domain dependency. Its adapter is a real but trivial checker so the whole loop can be exercised without any field's toolchain.

examples: Check that the candidate artifact equals the frozen expected value in the claim.

tiers.name: exact
tiers.description: Compares the artifact's normalized content against the claim's expected value. Deterministic and total: it cannot be argued into a pass, so it discharges the refute-attempt gate on its own.
tiers.two_sided_evidence: adapter/negative_control.txt is rejected at registration; the placeholder gate and the mismatch path both return fail in the fixture's own test run.
tiers.contamination_controls: The expected value lives in the frozen claim, not in the adapter; the adapter cannot see how the artifact was produced.

tiers.name: sampled
tiers.description: Checks a random subset of the artifact's entries under a seed. Present so the fixture exercises the graded path too — a pass here is evidence about the sample, not the whole.
tiers.contamination_controls: Sample indexes are seeded from the frozen target hash, so the producer cannot choose which lines are checked.

receipt_format.freshness_rule: The receipt records the artifact's SHA-256 at check time. It is stale if that hash differs from the artifact's current hash, which the exit gate recomputes rather than trusting the recorded value.

escalation.failure_signature: The pair (failure_class, normalized first line of the checker diagnostic). Two failures with the same pair are the same failure, and a repeat escalates immediately rather than waiting for the count.

refute_attempt.name: exact-recheck
refute_attempt.description: Re-runs the exact tier against the artifact's current bytes. Because that tier is deterministic and total, surviving it is a genuine refutation attempt rather than a second friendly run.

additional.name: placeholder-scan
additional.description: Rejects an artifact still containing TODO, FIXME, placeholder, or omitted. Every field needs this gate; only the token set differs.
